about_the_game:
Description:
《Roguelike Journey to the West: 100 Ways to Kill Erlang Shen》 is a 3D light-strategy roguelike game blending shooting, action, and tower defense mechanics. The game is a rougelike game that can be networked online to form teams .Characters auto-attack while wielding 6 weapons and have 3 revives per run. With 184 weapons, 174 items, and 40 heroes, the game offers extreme roguelike freedom and endless build possibilities.

Story:
The balance of the Three Realms has been shattered by an unknown force, causing time-space distortions and chaotic spiritual energy. As a result, creatures across the world awaken—heroes from Journey to the West are revived, historical legends return, and even ordinary humans gain supernatural powers. Meanwhile, demons grow stronger and more violent, led by the fallen god Erlang Shen, who seeks to slaughter all realms. In this epic war, the awakened heroes must unite and defeat 100 incarnations of Erlang Shen to collect Spirit Crystals and save the world.

Game Features:

✔ Online: This game supports online play, you can play online with netizens, you can give each other props in online mode, you can rescue teammates, and end the game when all players die.

✔ One-Hand Friendly: Control movement to dodge and collect loot while your character auto-fires 6-12 weapons.
✔ Classes & Builds: Mix and match Ranged, Melee, Elemental, and Mechanical classes with countless weapons and items—discover the strongest combo!
✔ Stress Relief: Slay thousands of monsters across 20 waves per run—pure carnage fun!
✔ Weapons & Items: Over 50+ weapons & 170+ items—no unlocks needed, just luck!
✔ Rune System: Customize 8 runes per hero and upgrade them progressively.
✔ Divine Artifact Trial Cards: Struggling? Use Artifact Fragments (dropped in runs) to exchange for OP temporary gear—dominate from start to finish!
